query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商环境标准'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“绿色采购”；仅有企业自身环境政策；仅有供应商劳工准则而无环境条款；仅有一次性供应商培训活动；区分：本指标聚焦供应链环境准入与约束；供应商行为准则可能同时含劳工与环境，需抽出环境条款；企业环境政策不等于已对供应商设硬性标准；道德采购更偏人权/合规采购。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Only suppliers on the list of qualified suppliers are selected by our subsidiaries and their priorities are determined based on their track records. The list of qualified suppliers is updated once a year. Based on the annual, periodic and individual-item assessments conducted by the Procurement Department on all suppliers, suppliers who do not meet the criteria and who have been warned repeatedly will be removed from the procurement list, and we will terminate our partnership with them. During the year under review, 52 supplier assessments took place for the coatings and inks businesses, which is a significant increase over the preceding year. This is mainly due to the growth of the coatings business leading to the addition of new suppliers of auxiliary materials and original equipment manufacturers (OEM). results.text: As one of the first companies in the China inks industry to introduce a hazardous substance management system, Bauhinia Ink, the Group's subsidiary, has established a hazardous substance database and a regulations database to control over 40 substances such as heavy metals and organic compounds in its products, and to ensure compliance with relevant product standards and environmental standards in countries and regions including the European Union, the United States, and Japan. We continuously improve our ability to assess product safety, and manage and control risks in inks plants by adopting fully pipelined manufacturing in benzene-free production conditions, while control systems are automatic and linked to an ERP system for comprehensive production process monitoring.

[Content]
Most of the Group's subsidiaries have implemented ISO 9001 Certified Quality Management System and monitored the entire process from product R&D, production, and quality inspection to product delivery through an Enterprise Resource Planning ('ERP') system. Our products have also received a number of certifications for quality assurance, including China Environmental Labelling Product Certification, China Compulsory Product Certification, China Classification Society Certification, American UL Product Safety Certification, French VOC A+ Certification, and American GREENGUARD Gold Certification.

results.section: 排放物管理 EMISSION MANAGEMENT
results.text: During the year under review, the Group's greenhouse gas emissions in scope 1 and scope 2 increased by 19% and 13% year-on-year respectively, mainly due to the increase in overall energy consumption of electricity, petrol, diesel and natural gas of the three plants. However, when measured by per tonne of products, the greenhouse gas emission level was maintained a similar level as compared to 2020.

[Section]
排放物管理 EMISSION MANAGEMENT

[Content]
During the year under review, the Group's greenhouse gas emissions in scope 1 and scope 2 increased by 19% and 13% year-on-year respectively, mainly due to the increase in overall energy consumption of electricity, petrol, diesel and natural gas of the three plants. However, when measured by per tonne of products, the greenhouse gas emission level was maintained a similar level as compared to 2020.
